issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes path semantics with no stated precondition or comment
issues.detail: The fix reverses resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s), treating `from` as a file path whose parent contains the sources. This is likely correct per sourcemap spec, but the invariant is undocumented and edge cases (URL `from`, directory `from`, absolute `s`) are not pinned by any direct DecodedMap unit test.

issues.description: getSourceMap performs synchronous readFileSync per stack frame with no memoization
issues.detail: Each frame triggers existsSync + readFileSync + convertSourceMap.fromSource against the same external file, turning stack symbolication into O(frames * fileSize) where O(uniqueFiles * fileSize) suffices. A simple Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache keyed by path would fix the constants without changing correctness.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' fallback that silently masks malformed map references
issues.detail: When a referenced map file is missing, the reader returns the string '{}' as an empty source map. This conflates missing files with malformed sourceMappingURL comments and erases a real diagnostic signal. Either propagate the failure, return undefined, or document the suppressed failure mode and cite the Vite precedent.

issues.description: External-module heuristic `!mod?.transformResult && existsSync(file)` is undocumented and fragile
issues.detail: The check complects module identity, transform state, and filesystem existence into a single folklore assertion about externality. If Vite ever populates transformResult for externalized modules, source maps will be silently skipped. Extract an `isExternalUntransformed(file)` predicate and state the Vite invariant being relied on.

issues.description: Correctness rests only on snapshot diffs; no direct unit test pins the resolve() or extraction semantics
issues.detail: The only evidence of correctness is updated stacktrace snapshots. Edge inputs (absolute sources entries, URL `from`, sources containing '..', maps outside the package) are untested. A focused DecodedMap.resolvedSources test and an extractSourcemapFromFile test would catch future regressions when someone 'optimizes' the resolution rule again.

issues.description: New convert-source-map dependency duplicates capability of existing @jridgewell toolchain and is copy-pasted from Vite
issues.detail: The package already uses @jridgewell/trace-mapping for parsed maps; convert-source-map introduces a second mental model for the same value. The extractSourcemapFromFile helper is inlined from a specific Vite commit with no shared abstraction, so it will drift silently. Justify the duplication or import from Vite if exposed.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch fixes a real bug — external module stack frames now get source-map resolution — and that the direction is correct. However, all three reviewers flag the same core weakness: the resolve(from, '..', s) semantic shift is undocumented and unsupported by direct unit tests, and the new getSourceMap callback does blocking per-frame I/O with no memoization. Two reviewers further fault the '{}' fallback as defensive programming that erases failure signals and the `!transformResult` externality heuristic as undocumented folklore. Consensus: correct intent, under-audited execution; address the P1s (invariant + memoization) before landing.
